declarations. Resolve concrete library bindings and auxiliary proof details

coherent Lean representation preserving domains, assumptions, quantifiers and
the full target. Definitions cannot hide unproved results or stronger assumptions.

def scalarRing (p : ℕ) : Subring ℚ :=

def divided {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (a : Module.End ℂ V) (r : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ V :=

    (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : V := divided y i v

  letI := ZMod.algebra K p

  ∃ κ : R p →+* K, ∃ C : RK κ M ≃ₗ[K] VK K M,
    canonicalR κ M C ∧ ∀ i, β i = C (pureR κ 1 (B i))
